benefits.name: Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit toward incidental air travel fees such as baggage fees, flight-change fees, in-flight food and beverage purchases, and airport lounge day passes.
benefits.terms: Up to $100 per calendar year toward incidental air travel fees, not the cost of the ticket itself.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.
benefits.terms: Up to $100 for Global Entry or $85 for TSA PreCheck. Reported renewal cadence varies by source (roughly every 4-5 years, matching the underlying program's own renewal cycle); confirm current cadence before relying on it.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary annual Priority Pass Select membership providing access to 1,200+ airport lounges worldwide, with an accompanying guest.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required through PenFed to activate the Priority Pass Select membership.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision/Loss Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for physical damage, theft, reasonable and customary towing, and loss-of-use charges on most rental vehicles.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 per purchased ticket for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed more than 12 hours.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for cell phone damage or theft when the monthly bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Requires paying the monthly cell phone bill with the card.

earningRates.terms: Standard rate is 3x points on travel purchases. Honors Advantage members (PenFed checking account holders or eligible military-affiliated members) earn 4x on travel instead; that tier isn't separately modeled here.
